implementation_status.vfs: bounded in-memory bootstrap store; no block-device-backed filesystem mount layer
implementation_status.qfs: on-disk superblock/formatter contract only; directory, extent, journal, mount and recovery implementation incomplete
implementation_status.fat: no native kernel block-backed FAT12/16/32 driver verified
implementation_status.ntfs: no native kernel block-backed NTFS3 driver verified
implementation_status.xfs: no native kernel block-backed XFS driver verified
implementation_status.other_filesystems: not certified; runtime presence of external tools does not establish native kernel support

policy: QFS remains the intended native Chimera filesystem. This profile lists candidates, not delivered drivers. The installer may expose a backend only after read-only runtime checks verify a whole-disk block device, required utilities, a registered kernel mount driver and a matching formatter. Never select or format an unverified backend.
